metadata.case_name: NGAI LUNG HING v. GOWIN ENGINEERING CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Casual worker (general labouring; operating concrete breaking equipment such as pneumatic drills, jack hammers and electrical hand held machines; drove light goods vans; sometimes supervised other workmen as a foreman)
plaintiff.occupation_after: General labourer with Sendon Electrical Service (restricted to light duties)

injuries.description: 70% cut of the brachioradialis muscle bulk; similarly of the extensor carpi radialis longus and extensor carpi radialis brevis
source: The injury comprised a 70% cut of the brachioradialis muscle bulk; similarly of the extensor carpi radialis longus and extensor carpi radialis brevis. There was no fracture or other injury to any bone. Suturing was undertaken of the muscle bulk, and he was discharged three days later.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

manifestations.description: pain and numbness of the right forearm; sometimes this occurred when he was at rest
limited range of flexibility of his right wrist
right handgrip was significantly weaker than his left
weakness and pain of the right arm on exertion, which prevented use of power tools and resumption of his pre-accident job
stiffness of the wrist assessed at 4% and weakness due to muscle injury assessed at 6% impairment of the whole person (total 10%)

losses.description: Limited range of flexibility of his right wrist, significantly weaker right handgrip, and persistent pain and numbness of the right forearm
Prevented use of power tools and resumption of pre-accident heavy duty job; obliged to change to lighter duties and restricted employment (could not safely undertake prolonged driving)

comparable_cases.injury_description: Injury to muscles, tendons and nerves from an attack with a chopper
Fracture of the wrist or arm
